description: Read or set margins and columns (Layout > Margins and Columns) on document pages, on the pages of parent spreads, or as the document default for new pages: each margin or one value for all sides ("Make all settings the same"), columns, gutter, direction, and custom column positions (column guides moved by hand)

action.description: Read the settings, or set the ones given

columnsPositions.description: Custom column guide positions in mm from the left margin, in the form InDesign reports them (read them with action get first); sets customColumns

documentDefault.description: Change the document default used for new pages

margin.description: One margin for all four sides, mm ("Make all settings the same")

margins.description: Margins and columns to set (MarginPreference); measurements in mm

customColumns.description: Keep custom (dragged) column guide positions; false spaces columns evenly

parents.description: Parent (master) spread names, e.g. "A-Parent"; every page of each is changed

name: set_margins_and_columns
title: Set Margins And Columns
